notes: Needs ruling (rule 6): «قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ» names the speaker only by a pronoun, and no previous report is supplied to name him, so no Imam is written.
«أبي» is bare: a relation link (rule 7). «أخيه الحسن» is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7).
«(رحمه الله)» is left out; the saying is the quoted Quranic passage and its gloss.
